西日本最大のゲイバー「EAGLE OSAKA」2024年3月大阪堂山町にオープン!EAGLE TOKYO GROUP3店舗目となる「EAGLE OSAKA」が西日本最大級のゲイバーとしてオープン。1階は週末にはDJパーティが開催されるダンスフロア、2階は横丁にゲイバーやアパレルショップが軒を連ねています。もちろん人気アーティスト児雷也氏による壁画もあります!EAGLE OSAKA spread its wings in March 2024，marking the vibrant addition of the third venue to the esteemed EAGLE TOKYO GROUP. Nestled in Doyama-cho，Osaka，it proudly stands as one of western Japan's premier gay bars，offering a dynamic experience for its patrons. Boasting expansive spaces，the first floor hosts exhilarating DJ parties on weekends，while the second floor invites guests to unwind in a Yokocho-style bar，open daily. Complementing the ambiance is Nippondanji，our exclusive gay apparel shop. True to our brand，the second-floor bar features an original Jiraiya mural，echoing the distinctive charm of our Eagle establishments.
